checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-EXT-TRACE-REQUEST: Trace Request Input Validation and Resource Bounding
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Invoke debug_traceTransaction with a non-existent transaction hash and verify the RPC returns an appropriate error without consuming excessive resources. 2. Submit a trace request for a transaction known to execute an extremely gas-intensive contract (e.g., large loop). Measure memory and CPU consumption on the server side; confirm bounded resource usage (timeout or gas cap). 3. Verify that rate limiting is enforced on the debug_traceTransaction endpoint by sending a burst of requests and observing throttling behavior. 4. Attempt to pass malformed hex strings, oversized payloads, and injection patterns in the transaction hash parameter.
executable_checks: grep -r 'traceTransaction\|debug_trace' --include='*.go' to locate handler
Check for timeout/gas-cap configuration in trace handler
Test with invalid tx hash formats (empty, too short, too long, non-hex chars)
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-EIP3155-PRECOND-002. Boundary edge EDGE-EXT-TRACE-REQUEST from external RPC users to EL trace subsystem. Related to ASSUM-EIP3155-01. Trust model edge EDGE-USER-TRACE-REQUEST.

checklist.title: Verify Trace Request Parsing Validates Transaction Hash Existence Before Execution
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Trace the code path from RPC handler to EVM trace execution. Confirm that transaction lookup occurs before any trace execution begins. 2. Verify that a missing transaction results in an early return with a descriptive error, not a nil-pointer dereference or empty trace. 3. Check that the lookup uses the canonical chain and does not return transactions from uncle/ommer blocks.
executable_checks: Review trace handler for tx lookup before execution
Test with tx hash from non-canonical block
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-EIP3155-PRECOND-002. Node STATE-TRACE-REQUEST-RECEIVED. Verifies internal handling after data crosses the boundary.

checklist.title: Verify Resource Exhaustion Mitigations for Trace Execution
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Identify the gas cap or step limit applied during trace replay. Confirm it is configurable and has a reasonable default. 2. Verify that memory allocations during trace collection are bounded (e.g., max trace output size). 3. Test tracing a contract that performs MAX_UINT256 iterations and confirm the trace terminates within bounds. 4. Check for goroutine/thread limits on concurrent trace requests.
executable_checks: Locate gas cap configuration for debug_trace*
Check for memory limits on trace output buffers
Verify concurrent request limiting
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-EIP3155-PRECOND-002. Node STATE-RESOURCE-EXHAUSTION-RISK. Supports boundary by ensuring resource bounds post-entry.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-ATTACKER-SENDS: Snappy Varint Header Validation Against Overflow
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Craft a Snappy-compressed message with a varint header encoding a value > 2^32-1. Send it to a peer's DEVp2p connection. 2. Verify the peer immediately terminates the connection without attempting decompression. 3. Craft a message with varint exactly at 2^32-1 and verify it is accepted or rejected per implementation policy. 4. Verify that the decompressed size check occurs BEFORE memory allocation for the decompression buffer. 5. Confirm that no partial decompression occurs on overflow detection.
executable_checks: Locate Snappy decompression entry point in p2p code
Check varint parsing for overflow guard before memory allocation
Test with varint = 0xFFFFFFFF+1 encoded in LEB128
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-EIP706-PRECOND-003. Boundary edge EDGE-ATTACKER-SENDS from malicious peer to EL DEVp2p Snappy pipeline. Related to ASSUM-EIP706-03.

checklist.title: Verify Varint Limit Check Implementation Correctness
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Review the varint decoding function. Verify it uses unsigned 64-bit or larger arithmetic to avoid truncation. 2. Check that the comparison is strictly against the maximum allowed value (2^32-1). 3. Verify the check cannot be bypassed by encoding the same value in multiple varint byte lengths. 4. Confirm the function handles malformed varint encoding (e.g., excessive continuation bytes) without entering an infinite loop.
executable_checks: Review varint decoder for correct bit-width arithmetic
Test with overlong varint encodings
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-EIP706-PRECOND-003. Node ACTION-CHECK-VARINT-LIMIT. Supports boundary by verifying internal varint parsing correctness.

checklist.title: Verify Connection Termination on Varint Overflow Detection
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Confirm that upon detecting varint overflow, the connection is closed immediately (not deferred). 2. Verify that no further reads from the connection occur after overflow detection. 3. Check that the peer is recorded/penalized to prevent reconnection abuse. 4. Verify that connection cleanup releases all allocated buffers.
executable_checks: Trace error handling path from varint check failure to connection close
Verify peer scoring/banning on protocol violation
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-EIP706-PRECOND-003. Node STATE-VARINT-OVERFLOW. Verifies proper teardown after boundary violation detected.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-RECV-TO-VALIDATE-BLOB: Blob Sidecar Index and KZG Validation at Gossip Ingress
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Publish a blob sidecar on the gossip network with blob index >= MAX_BLOBS_PER_BLOCK_ELECTRA. Verify the receiving node rejects it at the gossip validation layer (REJECT, not IGNORE). 2. Publish a blob sidecar with a valid index but invalid KZG commitment. Verify rejection. 3. Publish a blob sidecar with mismatched index vs. subnet ID. Verify rejection. 4. Send a BlobSidecarsByRange request exceeding MAX_REQUEST_BLOB_SIDECARS_ELECTRA and verify truncation/rejection. 5. Verify that all validation occurs before the blob is forwarded to other peers.
executable_checks: Locate gossip validation handler for blob_sidecar subnets
Check MAX_BLOBS_PER_BLOCK_ELECTRA constant usage in validation
Test with index = MAX_BLOBS_PER_BLOCK_ELECTRA (off-by-one)
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-ELECTRA-P2P-PRECOND-003. Boundary edge EDGE-RECV-TO-VALIDATE-BLOB from P2P blob network to CL gossip validation.

checklist.title: Verify Blob Sidecar Limit Validation Logic Completeness
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Review the validation function to confirm it checks: (a) blob index < MAX_BLOBS_PER_BLOCK_ELECTRA, (b) KZG commitment is on the curve, (c) KZG proof verifies against the commitment and blob data. 2. Verify the ordering of checks (cheap checks first). 3. Confirm that REJECT (not IGNORE) is returned for invalid blobs to ensure peer scoring penalty.
executable_checks: Review blob sidecar validation function for completeness
Check error return type (REJECT vs IGNORE)
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-ELECTRA-P2P-PRECOND-003. Node ACTION-VALIDATE-BLOB-SIDECAR-LIMITS. Supports boundary validation completeness.

checklist.title: Falsify Sync Committee beacon_block_root Consistency Invariant
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Construct a scenario where two sync committee messages reference different beacon_block_roots but are submitted for aggregation by the same aggregator. 2. Verify the aggregator rejects the mismatched message. 3. Attempt to include an aggregated contribution in a beacon block where the aggregate's beacon_block_root differs from the block's parent root. 4. Check that the state transition function rejects such a block.
executable_checks: Locate sync committee aggregation validation logic
Check beacon_block_root comparison in aggregate verification
Test with forked chain producing different roots at same slot
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-ALTAIR-INVARIANT-001. Nodes: ACTION-VERIFY-BLOCK-ROOT-MATCH, ACTION-AGGREGATE-CONTRIBUTIONS.

checklist.title: Falsify Sync Committee Subnet Subscription Duration Invariant
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Simulate a validator assigned to a sync committee. Verify it joins the subnet 1-4 epochs before the period starts. 2. Advance the state to the end of the sync committee period. Verify the validator remains subscribed throughout. 3. Attempt to trigger early unsubscription by simulating node restart mid-period. Verify re-subscription occurs. 4. Check behavior when a validator is assigned to consecutive periods.
executable_checks: Locate subnet subscription lifecycle management code
Check epoch offset calculation for early join
Test node restart during active sync committee period
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-ALTAIR-INVARIANT-002. Nodes: ACTION-JOIN-SUBNET, STATE-SUBNET-JOINED. Related: AMB-ALTAIR-VAL-02.

checklist.title: Falsify Arrow Glacier Difficulty Bomb Fake Block Number Computation
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Compute fake_block_number for block 10,700,000 (should be 0). Verify bomb component = 2^(-2) which should be 0 or 1 depending on implementation. 2. Compute for block 10,699,999 (negative fake number). Verify it is treated as 0, not as a large unsigned integer. 3. Compute for block 10,800,000 (fake = 100,000). Verify bomb = 2^(1-2) = 1. 4. Compute for block 11,000,000 (fake = 300,000). Verify bomb = 2^(3-2) = 2. 5. Check for integer underflow when actual_block < 10,700,000.
executable_checks: Locate difficulty calculation function
Check signed vs unsigned arithmetic for fake block subtraction
Test boundary: block = 10,700,000 exactly
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-ARROW-GLACIER-POSTCOND-001. Nodes: ACTION-COMPUTE-FAKE-BLOCK-NUMBER, ACTION-COMPUTE-BOMB-COMPONENT. Related: AMB-ARROW-GLACIER-01.

checklist.title: Falsify Beacon Block Construction Must Include Execution Payload
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Simulate a block proposal where the execution engine returns a valid payload. Verify the payload is placed in the correct field of BeaconBlockBody. 2. Simulate a scenario where get_execution_payload returns an error or timeout. Verify the proposer does not produce a block without a payload. 3. Verify the block is signed with the proposer's key and broadcast. 4. Submit a block with an empty execution payload and verify it is rejected by validators.
executable_checks: Locate block proposal logic post-Bellatrix
Check error handling for execution payload retrieval failure
Verify execution payload field is non-optional in BeaconBlockBody
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-BELLATRIX-POSTCOND-002. Nodes: ACTION-CONSTRUCT-BEACON-BLOCK, STATE-BLOCK-PROPOSED.

checklist.title: Falsify Block Validity Persistence After Blob Data Pruning
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Add a block that passes data availability checks to the fork choice store. 2. Advance the chain beyond MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOB_SIDECARS_REQUESTS. 3. Prune the blob data. 4. Verify the block is still considered valid in fork choice (not retroactively invalidated). 5. Attempt to re-validate the block after pruning and verify no data-availability error is raised for blocks below the pruning boundary.
executable_checks: Locate fork choice store and data availability check
Check that is_data_available() has epoch-based exemption
Verify pruning does not modify fork choice store entries
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-DENEB-FC-INV-001. Nodes: STATE-BLOCK-ACCEPTED, STATE-DATA-AVAILABLE. Related: AMB-DENEB-FC-02.

checklist.title: Falsify PayloadAttributes Completeness for Deneb forkchoiceUpdated
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Construct PayloadAttributes and verify parent_beacon_block_root (EIP-4788) field is present. 2. Send forkchoiceUpdated with PayloadAttributes missing parent_beacon_block_root. Verify the execution engine returns an error. 3. Verify all other required fields (timestamp, prev_randao, suggested_fee_recipient, withdrawals) are present. 4. Confirm the execution engine constructs a payload faithful to the provided attributes by comparing the returned payload's fields.
executable_checks: Locate PayloadAttributes construction in CL code
Check that parent_beacon_block_root is populated from parent block state
Test with nil/zero parent_beacon_block_root
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-DENEB-FC-PRECOND-003. Nodes: ACTION-BUILD-PAYLOAD-ATTRS, ACTION-SEND-FCU.

checklist.title: Falsify Account Emptiness Definition (nonce=0, balance=0, code empty, storage ignored)
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Create an account with nonce=0, balance=0, empty code, but non-empty storage. Verify it is classified as empty. 2. Create an account with nonce=1, balance=0, empty code. Verify it is NOT empty. 3. Create an account with nonce=0, balance=1, empty code. Verify it is NOT empty. 4. Create an account with nonce=0, balance=0, non-empty code. Verify it is NOT empty. 5. Verify that storage state does not influence the emptiness check.
executable_checks: Locate isEmpty/IsEmpty function for accounts
Check that storage is NOT part of the emptiness condition
Test edge case: account with only storage slots set
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-EIP158-INV-001. Nodes: ACTION-CHECK-EMPTINESS, STATE-ACCOUNT-EMPTY. Related: AMB-EIP158-01.

checklist.title: Falsify Empty-to-Nonexistent Account Transition Safety
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Deploy a contract that checks for the existence of another account via EXTCODESIZE or BALANCE. 2. Create the target account, make it empty (zero nonce, zero balance, no code). 3. Trigger the state cleanup that deletes empty accounts. 4. Verify the contract now sees the account as nonexistent. 5. Confirm that no security-critical contract logic is broken by this transition (e.g., access control based on account existence).
executable_checks: Locate empty account cleanup/pruning logic
Check for contracts that distinguish empty vs nonexistent
Verify state trie correctly removes empty accounts
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-EIP158-INV-002. Nodes: STATE-ACCOUNT-DELETED, STATE-EMPTY-ACCOUNTS-EXIST. Related: ASSUM-EIP158-03.

checklist.title: Falsify Fork Activation Monotonicity for EIP-1588 ProgPoW Transition
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Process a block at height 7,279,999 and verify pre-fork (Ethash) rules apply. 2. Process block 7,280,000 and verify ProgPoW rules activate. 3. Attempt to process block 7,280,001 under pre-fork rules and verify rejection. 4. Simulate a reorg that includes blocks both above and below the fork boundary. Verify that validation rules are correctly applied based on each block's height, not the chain tip.
executable_checks: Locate fork activation check for EIP-1588/ProgPoW
Check that block validation selects rules based on block number, not chain state
Test reorg crossing fork boundary
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-EIP1588-INVARIANT-001. Nodes: ACTION-CHECK-BLOCK-NUMBER, ACTION-APPLY-PROGPOW-RULES. Related: ASSUM-EIP1588-01.

checklist.title: Falsify Block Propagation Delay Bounds Under Increased Calldata
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Create blocks with maximum calldata (using 4-gas-per-byte non-zero cost from EIP-2028). Measure propagation time across a test network. 2. Verify that propagation delay stays within Sompolinsky-Zohar security bounds. 3. Compare propagation times of blocks with minimal vs maximal calldata. 4. Calculate the theoretical maximum block size at the 4-gas rate and verify network can handle it.
executable_checks: Calculate max calldata bytes at 4 gas/byte given block gas limit
Measure or estimate propagation delay for max-calldata blocks
Compare against security model threshold
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-EIP2028-INVARIANT-002. Nodes: ACTION-PROPAGATE-BLOCK, ACTION-MEASURE-PROPAGATION-DELAY. Related: AMB-EIP2028-01, ASSUM-EIP2028-01.

checklist.title: Falsify Access List Gas Proportionality Invariant
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Create a transaction with an access list containing 1000 addresses each with 100 storage keys. Compute expected intrinsic gas: 21000 + calldata + 1000*2400 + 100000*1900. 2. Verify the computed intrinsic gas matches the expected value. 3. Verify this exceeds the block gas limit, confirming oversized lists are bounded by gas. 4. Test with an access list that would consume exactly the block gas limit minus 21000 in access list costs.
executable_checks: Locate intrinsic gas calculation for type-1 transactions
Verify per-address (2400) and per-key (1900) costs are applied
Test with access list that maximizes entries within gas limit
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-EIP2930-INV-003. Nodes: ACTION-COUNT-ACCESS-LIST-ENTRIES. Related: AMB-EIP2930-03, ASSUM-EIP2930-03.

checklist.title: Falsify Intrinsic Gas Summation for EIP-2930 Access Lists
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Create a transaction with known access list entries and compute expected intrinsic gas manually. 2. Verify the implementation produces the exact expected total. 3. Include duplicate addresses in the access list. Verify each duplicate is charged the full 2400 gas (no deduplication discount). 4. Include duplicate storage keys under the same address. Verify each is charged 1900 gas. 5. Verify overflow handling when access list is very large.
executable_checks: Locate intrinsic gas calculation and access list iteration
Check for any deduplication logic (should be absent per spec)
Test: duplicate address with different storage keys vs same keys
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-EIP2930-POSTCOND-001. Nodes: ACTION-SUM-INTRINSIC-GAS, ACTION-CALC-ACCESS-LIST-GAS. Related: AMB-EIP2930-01.

checklist.title: Falsify Correct baseFee Field Inclusion Based on Fork Boundary
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Request a receipt for a transaction in a block just before the EIP-1559 activation. Verify baseFee is NOT present. 2. Request a receipt for a transaction in the first EIP-1559 block. Verify baseFee IS present. 3. Misconfigure the fork block number and verify the client produces incorrect receipts (baseFee present/absent at wrong block).
executable_checks: Locate receipt serialization and baseFee inclusion logic
Check fork block number configuration for EIP-1559
Test at exact fork boundary block
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-EIP3041-INV-001. Nodes: ACTION-VALIDATE-BASEFEE-INCLUSION. Related: ASSUM-EIP3041-01.

checklist.title: Falsify STOP Opcode Error Trace Suppression Rule
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Execute a transaction that triggers an error on a STOP opcode. Verify no trace line is generated for that STOP. 2. Execute a transaction that triggers an error on a non-STOP opcode (e.g., REVERT, INVALID). Verify a trace line IS generated with the error field populated. 3. Verify that STOP with no error produces a normal trace line. 4. Test with STOP at different call depths to verify consistency.
executable_checks: Locate trace output logic for STOP opcode
Check conditional for error suppression on STOP
Test STOP error at nested CALL depth > 1
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-EIP3155-POSTCOND-001. Nodes: ACTION-CHECK-STOP-ERROR, STATE-STOP-WITH-ERROR, STATE-NON-STOP-ERROR.

checklist.title: Falsify gasCost Field Accuracy in Trace Output
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Trace a transaction with known opcodes and verify each trace line's gasCost = gas_before - gas_after. 2. Test with memory-expanding opcodes (MSTORE to new memory) where gas includes memory expansion cost. 3. Test with CALL opcodes where gas is split between caller and callee. Verify gasCost reflects the caller's gas consumption. 4. Test with refund-generating opcodes (SSTORE clearing) and verify gasCost does not include refunds.
executable_checks: Locate gasCost computation in trace logger
Compare traced gasCost against manual computation for SSTORE
Test memory expansion gas in gasCost field
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-EIP3155-POSTCOND-003. Nodes: ACTION-COMPUTE-GAS-COST, STATE-OPCODE-EXECUTED.

checklist.title: Falsify Origin Re-approval Must Undergo Full Re-evaluation
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Approve an origin, then remove it due to a requirement violation. 2. Attempt to re-add the origin and verify the full evaluation process is triggered (not a cached approval). 3. Check for any code path that allows previously-approved origins to bypass re-evaluation. 4. Verify that removal clears all cached approval state for that origin.
executable_checks: Locate origin approval and removal logic
Check for cached approval state that persists after removal
Test re-approval flow end-to-end
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-EIP5757-POSTCOND-001. Nodes: ACTION-REAPPLY, STATE-ORIGIN-REMOVED, STATE-REAPPROVED.

checklist.title: Falsify Version Negotiation and Compression Mode Selection
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Connect with local_version=5 to a peer with remote_version=4. Verify negotiated version = 4 and messages are uncompressed. 2. Connect with local_version=5 to a peer with remote_version=5. Verify negotiated version = 5 and all messages use Snappy. 3. After negotiating v5, send an uncompressed message. Verify it is rejected. 4. After negotiating v4, send a Snappy-compressed message. Verify it is rejected or ignored.
executable_checks: Locate version negotiation in DEVp2p handshake
Check compression toggle based on negotiated version
Test version mismatch scenarios
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-EIP706-POSTCOND-001. Nodes: ACTION-NEGOTIATE-VERSION, STATE-VERSION-4-NEGOTIATED, STATE-VERSION-5-NEGOTIATED. Related: ASSUM-EIP706-04.

checklist.title: Falsify Snappy Decompression Failure Handling
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Send a message with a valid Snappy header but corrupted compressed data. Verify the message is rejected. 2. Verify the peer connection is terminated or the peer is penalized. 3. Send multiple corrupted messages in sequence and verify no state corruption accumulates. 4. Verify that partial decompression results are discarded entirely.
executable_checks: Locate Snappy decompression error handling
Check peer disconnection on decompression failure
Test with truncated compressed data
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-EIP706-POSTCOND-003. Nodes: ACTION-DECOMPRESS-SNAPPY, STATE-MESSAGE-DECOMPRESSED. Related: AMB-EIP706-01, ASSUM-EIP706-01.

checklist.title: Falsify Blob Count Limit Enforcement (max 6 blobs per transaction)
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Submit a blob transaction with exactly 6 blobs. Verify acceptance. 2. Submit a blob transaction with 7 blobs. Verify immediate rejection. 3. Submit a blob transaction with 0 blobs. Verify rejection (if required by spec). 4. Check that the limit is enforced at both the mempool and block validation layers.
executable_checks: Locate blob count validation in transaction validation
Check both mempool and block-level enforcement
Test boundary: 6 blobs (valid) vs 7 (invalid)
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-EIP7594-PRECOND-002. Nodes: ACTION-VALIDATE-BLOB-COUNT, STATE-BLOB-COUNT-INVALID.

checklist.title: Falsify Cell Proof Batch Verification Determines Transaction Validity
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Submit a blob transaction with valid cell proofs. Verify batch verification succeeds and transaction enters mempool. 2. Corrupt one cell proof in a batch. Verify the entire batch verification fails and the transaction is rejected. 3. Verify that partial verification success does not allow the transaction through. 4. Test with empty proof set and verify correct handling.
executable_checks: Locate batch cell proof verification function
Check that failure of any single proof fails the entire batch
Test with one invalid proof among many valid ones
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-EIP7594-POSTCOND-002. Nodes: ACTION-BATCH-VERIFY-CELL-PROOFS, STATE-BLOB-TX-VALID, STATE-BLOB-TX-REJECTED.

checklist.title: Falsify EOF Code Section Opcode Validation at Deploy Time
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Create an EOF container with a code section containing an invalid opcode (e.g., 0xEF). Attempt deployment. Verify rejection. 2. Create an EOF container with multiple code sections, one valid and one containing an invalid opcode. Verify the entire container is rejected. 3. Verify that all opcode bytes are checked, including those at the end of a code section. 4. Test with opcodes that are valid in legacy but invalid in EOF.
executable_checks: Locate EOF code validation (EIP-3670 opcode check)
Check that ALL code sections are validated, not just the first
Test with invalid opcode at last byte of code section
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-EIP7692-PRECOND-003. Nodes: ACTION-VALIDATE-CODE, STATE-CODE-VALID, STATE-CODE-INVALID. Related: ASSUM-EIP7692-02.

checklist.title: Falsify Minority Attacker Cannot Prevent Honest IL Committee Broadcasts
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Simulate a scenario with an attacker controlling 1/3 of inclusion list committee members. 2. Have the attacker attempt to eclipse honest committee members (suppress their gossip messages). 3. Verify that honest members' inclusion lists are still propagated to the network. 4. Check for redundant peer connections or alternative propagation paths that mitigate eclipse attacks.
executable_checks: Review IL committee gossip propagation topology
Check for peer diversity requirements in IL subnet
Analyze minimum connectivity needed for liveness
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-EIP7805VAL-INV-002. Nodes: STATE-ASSIGNED-TO-IL-COMMITTEE. Related: ASSUM-EIP7805VAL-03.

checklist.title: Falsify Inclusion List Signing Domain and Deadline Enforcement
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Construct an inclusion list signed with the wrong domain (e.g., DOMAIN_BEACON_ATTESTER instead of DOMAIN_INCLUSION_LIST_COMMITTEE). Verify it is rejected by peers. 2. Broadcast an inclusion list after the submission deadline (~67% into slot). Verify it is ignored/rejected. 3. Verify the BLS signature is validated against the correct validator public key. 4. Test with a valid signature but for the wrong slot.
executable_checks: Locate IL signing logic and domain constant
Check deadline enforcement in gossip validation
Test with DOMAIN_INCLUSION_LIST_COMMITTEE vs other domains
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-EIP7805VAL-PRECOND-002. Nodes: ACTION-CONSTRUCT-SIGNED-IL, STATE-IL-BROADCAST. Related: AMB-EIP7805VAL-01.

checklist.title: Falsify Transaction Metadata Validation Against Announcement
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Announce a transaction with specific metadata (hash, type, size, sender, nonce). 2. When the peer requests it via GetPooledTransactions, return a transaction with a different type. Verify the requester flags the announcer as a protocol violator. 3. Return a transaction with a different size. Verify flagging. 4. Return a transaction with a different sender. Verify flagging. 5. Verify that hash mismatch is also detected.
executable_checks: Locate metadata comparison after GetPooledTransactions response
Check which fields are compared (hash, type, size, sender, nonce)
Verify peer scoring/disconnection on mismatch
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-EIP8077-POSTCOND-001. Nodes: ACTION-VALIDATE-METADATA-MATCH, ACTION-FLAG-PROTOCOL-VIOLATION. Related: AMB-EIP8077-02.

checklist.title: Falsify 9-Subnet Distribution Sufficiency for Electra Blob Count
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Calculate the maximum number of blobs per block under Electra (MAX_BLOBS_PER_BLOCK_ELECTRA). Verify 9 subnets can distribute them without overloading any single subnet. 2. Simulate peak blob production with all subnets at capacity. Measure propagation delay. 3. Test with uneven blob index distribution (e.g., all blobs assigned to subnet 0). Verify redistribution or rejection.
executable_checks: Check blob-to-subnet assignment algorithm
Calculate max blobs per subnet at peak load
Compare propagation delay at peak vs normal load
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-ELECTRA-P2P-INV-002. Nodes: STATE-MSG-ACCEPTED. Related: ASSUM-ELECTRA-P2P-02.

checklist.title: Falsify MAX_REQUEST_BLOB_SIDECARS_ELECTRA Derivation Consistency
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Verify MAX_REQUEST_BLOB_SIDECARS_ELECTRA == MAX_REQUEST_BLOCKS_DENEB * MAX_BLOBS_PER_BLOCK_ELECTRA by reading the constants. 2. Verify MAX_REQUEST_BLOCKS_DENEB is unchanged from Deneb. 3. Send a BlobSidecarsByRange request with count = MAX_REQUEST_BLOB_SIDECARS_ELECTRA. Verify it is accepted. 4. Send with count = MAX_REQUEST_BLOB_SIDECARS_ELECTRA + 1. Verify rejection.
executable_checks: Locate constant definitions for MAX_REQUEST_BLOB_SIDECARS_ELECTRA
Verify derivation formula in code or spec
Test boundary request size
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-ELECTRA-P2P-INV-004. Nodes: ACTION-PROCESS-BLOBS-BY-RANGE, ACTION-PROCESS-BLOBS-BY-ROOT. Related: AMB-ELECTRA-P2P-01.

checklist.title: Falsify Osaka Fork Activation Includes All Prior Fork Rules
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Activate the Osaka fork in a test environment. 2. Execute transactions that rely on features from each prior fork (Frontier through Prague). Verify correct behavior. 3. Specifically test edge cases at fork boundaries (e.g., EIP-1559 gas pricing, EIP-4844 blob gas). 4. Verify the state transition function applies rules cumulatively.
executable_checks: Locate fork activation chain configuration
Verify Osaka config includes all prior fork block/timestamp activations
Test representative transactions from each prior fork era
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-OSAKA-INVARIANT-001. Nodes: ACTION-CHECK-FORK-BLOCK. Related: AMB-OSAKA-01, ASSUM-OSAKA-01.

checklist.title: Falsify State Trie Determinism After Transaction Execution
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Process the same block on two independent nodes. Compare the resulting state roots. Verify they are identical. 2. Process transactions that touch the same storage slots in different orders within the same block. Verify the final state root is order-independent (since intra-block ordering is fixed). 3. Test with transactions that create and delete accounts in the same block. 4. Verify trie hashing algorithm produces consistent results across implementations.
executable_checks: Locate state trie update and root computation
Compare state roots across two independent executions of the same block
Test with account creation + deletion in same block
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-OSAKA-INVARIANT-002. Nodes: ACTION-UPDATE-STATE-TRIE, STATE-TRIE-UPDATED.

checklist.title: Falsify valid_jump_destinations Immutability During Execution
checklist.bug_class: Runtime State Mutation / Jump Destination Injection
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Deploy a contract and verify the valid_jump_destinations set is computed before execution. 2. During execution, attempt to modify contract code via SSTORE to a code-containing address (should not affect jump destinations). 3. Verify that DELEGATECALL to another contract uses the callee's jump destinations, not the caller's. 4. Verify that CODECOPY cannot be used to influence the jump destination set at runtime.
executable_checks: Locate jump destination analysis (JumpdestAnalysis)
Verify the set is computed once and stored immutably
Check DELEGATECALL jump destination handling
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-PRAGUE-CTRL-INV-001. Nodes: ACTION-BUILD-WHITELIST, ACTION-SCAN-JUMPDESTS. Related: ASSUM-PRAGUE-CONTROL-01.

checklist.title: Falsify JUMPI Conditional Branching and Gas Charging
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Execute JUMPI with condition != 0 to a valid destination. Verify PC is set to destination. 2. Execute JUMPI with condition == 0. Verify PC is incremented by 1 (no jump). 3. Execute JUMPI with condition != 0 to an invalid destination. Verify execution halts with error. 4. Verify 10 gas (GAS_HIGH) is charged in all three cases. 5. Test with condition = MAX_UINT256 to verify non-zero detection.
executable_checks: Locate JUMPI opcode implementation
Check gas charge is 10 (GAS_HIGH) unconditionally
Test condition=0 vs condition=1 vs condition=MAX_UINT256
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-PRAGUE-CTRL-POSTCOND-002. Nodes: ACTION-EVAL-CONDITION, ACTION-VALIDATE-JUMPI-DEST, ACTION-INCREMENT-PC-JUMPI.

checklist.title: Falsify JUMPDEST Scan Cannot Be Spoofed by PUSH Data
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Create bytecode where a PUSH instruction's data contains 0x5B (JUMPDEST opcode byte). Verify the scanner does NOT mark that byte offset as a valid jump destination. 2. Attempt to JUMP to the data byte offset. Verify execution halts with invalid jump error. 3. Test with all PUSH variants (PUSH1 through PUSH32) embedding 0x5B in their data. 4. Test with consecutive PUSH instructions creating overlapping patterns.
executable_checks: Locate JUMPDEST scanner/analysis function
Verify scanner correctly skips PUSH operand bytes
Craft bytecode: PUSH2 0x5B00 followed by JUMP to offset of 0x5B
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-PRAGUE-CTRL-INV-003. Nodes: ACTION-SCAN-JUMPDESTS, STATE-WHITELIST-READY. Related: ASSUM-PRAGUE-CONTROL-03.

checklist.title: Falsify Tangerine Whistle Gas Cost Updates Are Enforced
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Execute CALL after the Tangerine Whistle fork and verify gas cost = 700 (not 40). 2. Execute BALANCE and verify cost = 400 (not 20). 3. Execute SLOAD and verify cost = 200 (not 50). 4. Execute SELFDESTRUCT and verify cost = 5000 (not 0). 5. Execute EXTCODESIZE and EXTCODECOPY and verify cost = 700 each. 6. Verify these costs cannot revert to pre-fork values under any configuration.
executable_checks: Locate gas cost table/schedule for Tangerine Whistle
Verify each updated opcode gas cost constant
Test all six affected opcodes post-fork
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-TANGERINE-INVARIANT-001. Nodes: ACTION-CHECK-GAS-COST-TW, ACTION-DEDUCT-INCREASED-GAS. Related: AMB-TANGERINE-01, ASSUM-TANGERINE-01.

checklist.title: Falsify SELFDESTRUCT Gas Charging with New Account Creation
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Execute SELFDESTRUCT with beneficiary = existing account. Verify gas charged = 5000. 2. Execute SELFDESTRUCT with beneficiary = non-existent account. Verify gas charged = 5000 + 25000 = 30000. 3. Execute SELFDESTRUCT with beneficiary = the contract itself (existing). Verify gas = 5000. 4. Verify that insufficient gas causes OOG, not a partial execution.
executable_checks: Locate SELFDESTRUCT gas computation
Check for account existence check on beneficiary
Test with beneficiary that exists vs does not exist
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-TANGERINE-PRECOND-001. Nodes: ACTION-DEDUCT-BASE-GAS, ACTION-CHECK-NEW-ACCOUNT, ACTION-DEDUCT-NEW-ACCOUNT-GAS.
